features.title: Choose your editor data folder
features.description: Keep games, worlds, encounters, scenery and player pieces in an inspectable folder. Managed data is copied and verified on restart; original files remain as a safety copy.

features.title: Restore scenery with your pack code
features.description: Activate and download your scenery without email verification. If Windows cannot read a saved pack identity, back it up and repair activation before entering your code.

features.title: Clear disposable cache
features.description: Storage opens without scanning your collection. Measure disk use when needed, or clear temporary cache while retaining your projects, models and account connections.

features.title: Repair or reinstall the launcher
features.description: The launcher shows its installation location and can repair missing files. Verified updates remove obsolete software versions. Uninstall retains your personal editor data.
